category.label: Claude tells
category.description: Phrasing that Claude 5.x models write far more often than people do.

source: Measured on 1.29M words of Opus 5.5 Claude Code replies against 1.13M words of npm READMEs and 87K words of pre-2023 commits; Anthropic's Opus 5.5 and Fable 5.1 prompting guides
notes: Every tier-1 row fired at most 0.02 times per 10,000 words in the README and commit baselines. The status-label row needs a verbless fragment at the start of a line or sentence, so `This is a known limitation, not a bug` stays with the `contrast` pack. The closing offer lives in `closing-offer.json` so it can be excluded alone.
